symptom: `while true begin if $C = 'a' then return 'A'; end if; … set $S = 'x'; end while;` was described with one '-- WARNING: … NOT equivalent to the microflow and must not be re-executed over it (mxcli #923, recombinable)' line per decision, and lint raised MDL-FLOW01 as often ('overlap 1 node(s)'), although describe -> exec reported Unchanged and mx check gave 0 errors.
cause: classify measured each branch body with reachableBefore(branch, join), stopping only at the join and the virtual exit. Each early return is its own end event, so the join is the exit; the false branch walked set -> header merge -> the decision itself -> its true branch's end event, which then counted as overlap.
insight: The reporter's diagnosis (back edge, structure.go) was exact; the minimal fix is to stop each branch walk at its own split — a branch that re-enters its split has gone round a loop. Stripping back edges via dominators would also work but changes the post-dominator input for every consumer (describe warnings, lint, labelCrossedMerges, normalizeCollection). Keep the crossing-diamond-inside-a-loop control: it must stay Interleaved, and it is the case a cruder 'ignore nodes that reach the split' filter would hide, since inside a loop every body node reaches the split.
